character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create an original, highly polished 2D pixel-art character for ShieldQuest, a cozy Singaporean urban life-simulation adventure game.

CHARACTER: Indian Singaporean male student, approximately 18–23 years old.

ART DIRECTION:
- Cozy modern life-sim pixel art, warm and polished.
- Detailed handcrafted pixel art with soft shading and clean selective outlines.
- Slightly stylized, natural proportions.
- Friendly and expressive face, readable at gameplay size.

APPEARANCE:
- Medium-deep brown skin tone.
- Short dark hair, neat and youthful.
- Casual oversized T-shirt in a muted or earthy tone.
- Polytechnic or student lanyard.
- Dark trousers or cargo pants.
- Sneakers.
- Backpack or casual student vibe.
- Relaxed, friendly expression.

SINGAPOREAN IDENTITY:
- Contemporary Singapore student fashion.
- Natural neighbourhood youth appearance.
- Practical clothing suitable for tropical weather.

SPRITE REQUIREMENTS:
- Full-body standing character, transparent background.
- Orthogonal low top-down perspective.
- Consistent proportions across all directional rotations.
- No background, no text, no fantasy outfit, no weapons.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET:
A premium, warm, modern Singaporean student character that fits a cozy pixel-art urban game.
